name: Deadly Eclipse
body:
School necromancy [darkness, death]; Level nightblade 5, occultist 5, saboteur 5, shaman 6, shaper 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect darkness in 20-ft. radius spread, 20 ft. high
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell creates a destructive area of shadows and negative energy, sapping the strength of creatures within. The lighting within the entire area plummets to darkness, as a deeper darkness spell. A living creature within the deadly eclipse takes 1d4 points of Strength damage each round on your turn while in the field. A Fortitude save negates the damage, but they must save again for each round they remain in the area. A creature reduced to 0 Strength by this effect is slain instantly. This is a negative energy effect. Creatures that are immune to negative energy or are healed by it do not lose Strength while in the deadly eclipse, though it is still considered dark to them as deeper darkness.
